30 weeks = 30 × 7 = 210 days.  
Add 7 more days → total 217 days.  
Start: 1185-08-10.  
Add 217 days:  
August has 31 days → from Aug 10 to Aug 31 is 21 days (31-10).  
217 - 21 = 196 days left.  
September 1185 has 30 days → 196 - 30 = 166.  
October has 31 → 166 - 31 = 135.  
November has 30 → 135 - 30 = 105.  
December has 31 → 105 - 31 = 74.  
January 1186 has 31 → 74 - 31 = 43.  
February 1186 has 28 (1186 not a leap year: 1186 ÷ 4 = 296.5) → 43 - 28 = 15.  
March 1186: 15 days → March 15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1186-03-15
